verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th aga(n)m hai jiau jal a(n)dhar meen chala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: As the path of fish in water is unknowable, the way of gurmukhs is also unapproachable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਗਾਸ ਉਡੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh khoj alakh hai jiau pa(n)khee aagaas udda(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: As the path of birds flying in the sky cannot be known, the thoughtful and search-orientated way of gurmukh is also imperceptible. It cannot be understood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਨਗਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat raharaas hai har cha(n)dhauree nagar vasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Holy congregation is the straight path for gurmukhs and this world is full of illusions for them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ta(n)bol ras piram piaalai ra(n)g chara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: As the four colours of betel catechu, betelnut, lime and betel lead become one (red) colour (of joy-giving love), the gurmukhs also enjoy the cup of the Lord's love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi cha(n)dhan vaas nivaas kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: As the fragrance of sandal comes to reside in other plants, they merging their consciousness into Word reside in the hearts of others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੂੰਜਿ ਕੂਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸ ਵਧੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran jugat koo(n)j kooram ha(n)s va(n)s vadha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: By means of knowledge, meditation and remembrance, they like cranes, tortoise and swans expand their family or tradition.
The gurmukhs come face to face with God, the pleasure of all fruits.
